purpose: compare CURRENT_SCORING_CONTRACT (registry v1 / policy v1 / shadow v5) against the TRUSTED R4E.5 percentile contract to scope the next-stage v2 valuation scoring migration

gaps.note: annual parent earnings -> trailing-twelve-month earnings; the trusted R4E.5 percentile is PE_A_TTM
latest year-end parent equity -> most-recent-quarter parent equity (MRQ); the trusted R4E.5 percentile is PB_A_MRQ
latest annual revenue -> trailing-twelve-month revenue; the trusted R4E.5 percentile is PS_A_TTM

gaps.trusted_contract: 3y + 5y (frozen, effective-first mapped to actual trade days, minimum sample gates 500 / 900)
gaps.note: the old engine consumed only a 3y self-history percentile; the trusted R4E.5 contract freezes exactly 3y and 5y; expanding is deferred, not silently recomputed

gaps.trusted_method: MIDRANK_EMPIRICAL_PERCENTILE; Decimal-only; strict <= midrank <= weak; exact rational rank_numerator/rank_denominator; independent DuckDB dual oracle; PIT-exact future-leakage gate
gaps.note: valuation percentiles must move to the trusted R4E.5 method identity; the old legacy self-history percentile is not interchangeable

gaps.old_behavior: numeric lower_better transform (lower percentile -> higher score) + textual cycle warning only
gaps.north_star_requirement: low PE at a possible cycle peak must not automatically receive a high valuation score
gaps.note: the numeric transform has no cycle-context gate; a formal cycle-context contract is required before PE numeric scoring is authorized
sensitivity NOT_STABLE plus one-issuer calibration and missing peer calibration keep production scoring blocked despite a trusted percentile upstream

review_notes: This matrix is a contract reconciliation; it does not compute any score and does not use actual percentile values to choose a method.
The current v1 registry/policy/shadow are validated as historically valid and immutable; the trusted R4E.5 percentile is the new upstream for future valuation inputs.
